args.description: crouches and presses the invisible opponent he is holding down to the floor with his free hand, then points a long curved black odachi sword with a violet ribbon down at it, then rises back into the ready stance. Only the character is drawn: the opponent is invisible, there is no other person in the frame; nothing comes out of the floor or the weapon. The whole weapon stays inside the picture. The character stays at the same place in the frame (the game moves him), always facing right, seen from the side; keep his look, proportions and colours exactly. Only the character is drawn, with what he holds: no glow, no energy, no projectile, no smoke, no dust, no ground, the whole body inside the picture.
args.subject_description: a young man with messy black hair and violet eyes, a long black coat with a ragged violet lining worn open over a dark shirt, black trousers and black boots, holding a long curved black odachi sword with a violet ribbon
args.initial_pose: holding an invisible opponent in front of him with both hands
